Settings navigate by DRILL-IN, not master-detail

Founder-locked preference (drill-in stack nav, recorded pre-08-28; reconfirmed for Settings 2026-08-28).

​

• Settings root lists rows (General, Branding, SEO, Export, Domains, Analytics, Localization, Custom code, Redirects, Headers, Forms, Integrations, Webhooks).

• Clicking a row slides its screen IN over the list, with a ‹ back header. One column, drawer width — never a two-pane master-detail.

• Every S7 screen board in this family draws the CONTENT of one drilled-in screen; the frame around it is this drill-in shell.

​

Why not master-detail: the drawer is 280–320px — no room for two panes, and the drill-in model is what the rest of the sidebar (Pages, Media, Brand) already does.
